rows.title: Galimatias | In English
rows.content: +358 45 125 0080 Ota yhteyttä Kirjaudu Galinettiin Kirjaudu OnEduunEnglishSwedish Kielikoulutus Kansainvälisyys Viestintävinkit Blogit Rekrytointi 30 YEARS OF EXPERIENCE IN STRATEGIES FOR LANGUAGE, COMMUNICATION AND INTERNATIONALISATION TRAINING GALIMATIAS HELPS YOU SUCCEED IN AN INTERNATIONAL CONTEXT In our training we pay attention to values and cultural differences that are an integral part of successful communication. Our key accounts see us as a partner who provides solutions and much more than language training. Together with our clients we create new service concepts and improve the current ones. If your organisation regularly invests in language training, you will benefit from contacting us. Galimatias Concept Ltd offers training in communication and organisational culture for business and government in over 30 languages. We provide translation and localisation services and specialise in technical manuals. We offer our clients added value, cost and time saving concepts. We are responsible for language and internationalisation training in several organisations in Finland and we are one of the leading companies in our sector. We provide cost-efficient solutions for successful activities both nationally and internationally. We have collaborators in Sweden, Russia, England, Germany, France, Malta, Poland and our network is expanding. The word Galimatias means gibberish, or small talk and exists also as an ancient word in the English language. Galimatias Concept Ltd was established in Helsinki, Finland in 1996 by Mr François Bergeron a trainer and translator from Montréal, Canada and Ms Therese Söderman, MEd, from Finland. LANGUAGE TRAINING Galimatias offers language training aligned with the strategy and demands of the client organisation as well as with the students' levels and needs. Our training is goal-directed and individually tailored for the specific needs of our clients. The course administration, our Extranet-service Galinet is an efficient on-line system provided for our clients. Our courses cover a wide spectrum from language courses for beginners to highly specialised instruction in advanced terminology for skilled professionals and executives. We offer advanced seminars in communication skills and media training. Distance learning and efficient internet-based courses in different languages are also possible. We have an extensive on-line material database. We also offer courses aiming at international language examinations such as Cambridge, IELTS or the Finnish National Certificates of Language Proficiency. We support learning through oral and written exercises, simulated work situations and teamwork. Our areas of expertise are oral communication, customer service, business, finance, law, HR, IT, technology, environment, construction, industry, insurance, entrepreneurship, presentation and negotiation skills, sales, marketing, advertising, design, education, written skills and advanced grammar. Finnish courses for foreigners consist of one of our main fields of activity for foreigners employed in Finland. We also offer longer integration training for immigrants (see below). Our trainers have a university degree, pedagogical proficiency or TEFL-studies (Teaching English as a Foreign Language) as well as several years experience in training adults. We have over 60 trainers in the Helsinki region and over 100 trainers all over Finland. According to our quality evaluations, the quality of Galimatias' training is above 4 on the scale 1 to 5, where 5 means excellent. We tailor the training to fit the activities and targets of the client organisation: 1. Needs analysis - We analyse the training needs of the organisation and the students.2. Level testing - We test the starting level of the students using our online level test, corresponding to the European Union A1-C2 scale.3. Target - We define the targets and present our concept for a successful training process.4. Course plan - We make a training programme based on the length of the training periods, targets and needs.5. Quality evaluation - We regularly evaluate the quality of training and maintain a close relationship with the client organisations.6. Progress - We keep track of the student attendance and learning results on our client specific Extranet-database. The client has access to this information. INTERNATIONALISATION Galimatias internationalisation training is designed for businesses and organisations already established abroad or planning to enter new global market areas. The aim is to give an understanding of a specific geographical market area related to the activities of the business or organisation, to culture, politics and basic values. The training comprises organisational culture, leadership, personnel development or negotiations. Our lecturers and trainers are experts in their areas with a solid educational background and extensive experience. Training will encompass lectures and workshops designed specifically for a certain organisation, open courses and seminars for participants from different companies or Internet-based training, or a combination of the above. INTEGRATION TRAINING FOR IMMIGRANTS Since 2013, Galimatias has been offering integration courses for immigrants. The integration training gives adult immigrants better opportunities to become part of the Finnish society. During the training, which takes about one year, our students learn the Finnish language, communication skills as well as pick up civic and working life skills. A personal vocational plan is made for each student in the beginning of the training. In the integration training we focus on language and functional learning with the aim of improving communication skills in different contexts. The integration training for immigrants follows the guidelines of the Finnish National Board of Education. TRANSLATION AND REVISION Galimatias translation and revision services cover all languages. We translate technical manuals, annual reports, brochures, speeches, websites and topics related for example to marketing, IT, technology, science, construction, environment and education. We translate demanding legal and financial documents. Our translators hold academic degrees, they have several years of experience in translation and revision and good references. Our translators use technical solutions and translation software. Our client benefits from a quicker delivery and coherent terminology throughout the collaboration and partnership with Galimatias. CONTACT For information in English about Galimatias, our services and courses, please contact Tiina Prauda, Account Manager, tiina.prauda@galimatias.fi mobile +358 (0)45 125 0080 Therese Söderman, President of the Board, therese.soderman@galimatias.fi, mobile +358 (0)40 534 9771 Our office is in Ruoholahti in the centre of Helsinki. You can start your language studies online before arriving and continue your studies through either online or in-person courses. The course search is called Finnishcourses.fi, and it lists language courses from different service providers. Finland is officially a bilingual country. In Finland, close to five million people speak Finnish as their mother tongue, and half a million more speak it as a second language. Swedish is the mother tongue of almost 300,000 people in Finland. Although in most places in the Helsinki capital region, you receive service in English, it is useful to know the basics of one of the local languages. Most Helsinki residents (76%) speak Finnish as their native language, and some (6%) speak Swedish. You can search for language courses organised in the Helsinki capital region, and the service also lists online courses. This means you can start your language studies online if you don’t live in Finland yet, or you can begin your studies once you have arrived. How to use the language course search 1. Go to the language course search (finnishcourses.fi). The default option is Finnish courses, and the Swedish course search can be found at the bottom of the page. 2. Select your preferred study location: If you haven’t arrived in Finland yet or if you want to study online, select online courses. If you are in the Helsinki capital region and don’t want to study remotely, select Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, or all of them (multiple options are possible). 3. Select your current level or the level at which you want to start your language studies. You can also choose other search options. 4. From the list, select a course you want to participate in. It is useful to read the course description carefully because some courses may, for example, include studying both online and in person. Please note that the language courses are organised by different service providers, and the cost of the courses varies. Centro Studi Italiani’s Business Italian Language Course is tailored to meet the specific needs of international companies. Our offering includes corporate Italian language courses designed to address linguistic training requirements within a business context. When a company requires effective communication with Italian clients, suppliers, Italian employees, or foreign employees in Italy, Centro Studi Italiani is committed to customizing courses to meet the individual needs of the students. Choose our school and leverage our 40 years of experience to help you and your staff excel in Italian language skills! You should participate in the course if: If you are a worker: • You will have the opportunity to improve your Italian if you have recently moved to Italy for work and/or if you use Italian within your working environment; • You will be able to take a personalized Italian course, organized according to your needs and consistent with your work sector; • You will be able to delve into the topics and skills you need to be successful in your job. If you are a company: • You will be able to rely on Centro Studi Italiani to organize Italian courses for your foreign employees; • You will be able to customize course content and program to be followed according to the needs of your workers; • You will be able to monitor your employees Italian language learning process. If you want to obtain a certification: • With us you will fill in your language gaps before taking the exam; • Our teacher will prepare you for the exam day; • We can guide your through simulations by with typical certification tests. Why choose our Business Italian language course? Equip your staff with the essential Italian language skills they need to thrive in today’s global market. Our business Italian language course provides practical, targeted training with a flexible approach to adapt to the specific needs of each participant. With four decades of experience in teaching Italian, we guarantee high-quality training that will enable your staff to acquire excellent language skills. What makes our corporate courses unique is our ability to customize teaching based on your company’s specific needs. Whether you aim to enhance internal or external communication, our qualified teachers will focus on the language aspects relevant to your industry and business situation. Trust us to enhance your Italian language skills and ensure that your staff can communicate confidently and efficiently in any business context. Choose Centro Studi Italiani for a personalized learning journey that will lead your company to new levels of success in linguistic communication. Ask for info Improve your Italian in Italy! Here is all the information you need before enrolling yourself or your employees in the Business Italian Language Course! Discover all the details of our customizable course and join the extended family at Centro Studi Italiani. Features of the Business Italian course If you aim to enhance your Italian proficiency for effective communication with clients, colleagues, and Italian suppliers; if you are considering relocating to Italy and are searching for the ideal solution for your Italian language course, or if you are a human resources manager seeking a flexible language training solution for your colleagues, the Business Italian Language Course offered by Centro Studi Italiani is the best choice for you. We can accommodate both small groups and individual lessons, adapting to your specific needs. We cover all proficiency levels, from A1 to C2, and the lesson schedule and frequency can be customized based on your language learning objectives. Upon completion of the course, we will provide you with a written assessment indicating your achieved level of language proficiency. On request, we can offer lesson reports regularly, for example, once a month, to keep you updated on progress and further tailor teaching based on your specific needs. With our personalized approach, we guarantee effective learning tailored to your individual requirements. Who is the course for? The course is open to students of any level of language proficiency. Registration and price Italian language course tuition We customize the program and cost of your course based on your specific needs. Each course includes: Business Italian Course; Accommodation support, if needed; Educational materials; Student ID; Administrative support; Insurance during lessons; Final exam (optional); Certificate of attendance. For further information, feel free to contact our student office. Centro Studi Italiani offers an accommodations and transfers service: conditions and options depend on the location chosen. Where’s the school? Centro Studi Italiani welcomes you to three vibrant locations: Milan: Immerse yourself in the style and energy of Italy’s fashion capital. Genoa: Discover the historic charm and coastal beauty of this Ligurian city. Urbania: Escape the crowds and experience authentic Italian life in a charming, welcoming town. No matter which location you choose, you can unlock a personalized learning journey with our flexible Business Italian language course, designed to meet your individual needs and goals. It is culture, love, family, and you have to be there to understand it.” ANTHONY LOPEZ(PANAMA) Fill out the form and get all the information you need FAQ 1. When does my course start? Online group courses: We offer three start dates per year for each level. Please confirm the exact start date with the student office, as it may vary. Private, couple, business, and exam preparation courses: These have flexible start dates, to be arranged directly with the student office. 2. How long is my course? Online group courses: Each module consists of 45 hours, usually held at a pace of 3 hours per week. This means a module typically lasts about 15 weeks (approx. 4 months). All other courses: Duration is flexible and depends on the number of hours purchased and the weekly schedule agreed with the student office. 3. Which days will my course be on? The days of your course will have to be agreed with the student office according to participant needs and teacher availability. 4. What happens if I need to interrupt my course? The remaining part of the course will be converted into a credit that you can use for another course within the same calendar year. 5. What happens if I choose a group course but there are no group classes at my level during my preferred period? If there is no available class at your level, the student office will inform you and offer two options: Postpone the start of your course, or Convert your group course into private lessons, based on the amount paid (the price for a private session of 60 minutes is €45). To help a company define the reasons for investing in language training for its employees, you could ask the following questions: Business Language Does the company have clients or business partners who speak a language other than the company's primary language? Market Language Does the company want to expand into new markets where a different language is spoken? If you are somewhat familiar with the Israeli business world, you must have already noticed the small but significant differences between the way you do business at home and the way things are done in Israel. For example, the way Hebrew speakers write a date (the day precedes the months) or refer to the parts of the day (1pm is not "the early afternoon" but "noon").We offer a course in business Hebrew that will help you navigate better within the Israeli business world.The course is custom-made to meet your specific needs: you can learn the Hebrew vocabulary used in the high tech industry, the structure of the academy in Israeli universities and colleges, how to write an email, questions asked in a job interview and more - all according to your specific needs and pace.Get to know the local business environment by practicing conversations and simulating with our qualified teachers who are all native speakers of Hebrew and live in Israel. Do you need Hebrew to acclimate in Israel? Would you integrate personally and professionally while using Hebrew if you could? Eran Katz – Guinness World Record Holder for Memory Creator of the MemoReach® Method Exclusive to New School The exclusive MemoReach® method by New School helps you learn a language and conquer memory challenges. Join our Conversational Hebrew course using the MemoReach® method developed alongside memory expert Eran Katz.As the top language school in Israel, we’ve created an innovative language learning approach that empowers you to overcome language barriers faster than you ever thought possible.We offer in-person Hebrew courses in Tel Aviv or online, with various tracks ranging from DAY2DAY Hebrew for beginners to advanced levels, including group courses and private lessons in Hebrew. What Does the Conversational Hebrew Course at New School Include? Practical LearningAt New School, you will learn Hebrew through practical training rather than just theory. We focus on developing speaking skills and listening comprehension in a natural way – just like how we learned our mother tongue. MethodologyTogether with Eran Katz, a global memory expert, we developed the exclusive MemoReach® method for Hebrew and other languages. With this method, you’ll learn effectively based on your individual learning characteristics. FlexibilityWe offer a variety of learning tracks during flexible hours, both in-person and online. Whether you’re a student, working, or on vacation – you can choose the time that suits you best for learning. AffordabilityYou don’t have to pay a fortune for lengthy courses taught in outdated ways. Come learn Hebrew at a fair price in an effective course designed just for you. Personalized LearningBefore the course, you’ll take a placement test, and following that, you will receive personal guidance to match you with an accurate learning path. Experiences from Students: "I really wanted to be able to speak with locals before my vacation in Italy. I was worried I wouldn't achieve that in three months, but with the help of my teacher and lots of practice, my vacation was beyond my imagination!" Yarden Kirshenbaum "It was a huge plus that New School is located in central Tel Aviv. Friendships formed among students during lessons, and afterwards we all went out for beers to practice our Arabic." Alon Aviv "I came to New School to learn Spanish and found a warm and family-like home – friendly staff, high-quality personal service, and the course prices are fair and worthwhile. I highly recommend it!" Or Mizrahi "From lesson to lesson, I felt significant improvement. The app with exercises and content really strengthened my learning, and even now after the course ended, we still chat and practice there." Rotem Simcha 🤖 New: 24/7 AI Tutors on WhatsApp Learning Hebrew as an English speaker is a journey. At New School, you’re not alone — beyond your personal teacher, you get access to AI Tutors 24/7 via WhatsApp, a unique feature you won’t find at any other Hebrew school in Israel. Why this matters for Hebrew learners: Random questions throughout the day: See a Hebrew sign and can’t read it? Snap a photo, send it to your AI tutor, get a translation + explanation in seconds. Pronunciation practice: Send a 30-second recording, receive precise feedback on your accent — explanations available in English, Russian, French, or Spanish. Real-life rehearsal: Have a meeting at Bituach Leumi? With your kids’ teacher? Practice the conversation with your AI tutor first. Hebrew alphabet at your own pace: Practice letters at unconventional hours — late night, during work breaks, on the train. Same context across sessions: The AI remembers exactly where you left off in your last lesson with the human teacher. 📱 Send us a WhatsApp message For more information about the courses, other languages, or general inquiries, please leave your details at the bottom of the page or send a message through the link. Why Hebrew is Hard for English Speakers (and How We Solve It) As an English speaker, Hebrew presents three unique challenges. Most language schools teach Hebrew the way they teach Spanish — but Hebrew is fundamentally different. Here’s the truth: 1. The RTL Reading Direction Your brain has spent decades reading left-to-right. Hebrew flips that. It’s not just visual — it changes how you scan, process, and absorb text. It takes 3-4 weeks of dedicated practice to feel natural. We use specific exercises that accelerate this transition. 2. Three-Letter Roots & Verb Conjugations Hebrew is a Semitic language. Instead of learning words individually, you learn a 3-letter root (e.g., כ-ת-ב for “writing”), and from it, 12-15 different forms (writer, was written, will write, etc.). Once you understand this pattern, your vocabulary explodes — but you need a teacher who explains it logically. 3. The Confidence Barrier You’ll understand Hebrew before you can speak it. Most people get stuck here. The solution isn’t more grammar — it’s more speaking in a safe environment. That’s why our 24/7 AI Tutors are critical: practice speaking with zero judgment, anytime. Who Is This Course For? 🛬 New Olim from English-speaking countries You just made aliyah from the US, UK, Canada, Australia, or South Africa. You need Hebrew for daily life: doctor visits, school meetings, banks, social services. 💼 Hi-tech professionals in Israel You work for an Israeli company in English, but want to integrate fully — speak Hebrew with colleagues, follow internal communication, build deeper relationships. 🌍 Diaspora Jews connecting to roots You live abroad but want to connect with Hebrew — for prayer, for travel to Israel, for family heritage, or for personal meaning. 🎓 Birthright / Masa / Gap year students You’re in Israel for 2-12 months. You want intensive Hebrew that gets you conversational fast — for friends, dating, daily life in Tel Aviv or Jerusalem. 📚 University students You’re applying to Hebrew University, Tel Aviv University, or Technion. You need academic-level Hebrew for lectures, papers, and exams. 👨‍👩‍👧 Parents of Hebrew-speaking children Your kids are in Israeli schools. They speak Hebrew. You feel disconnected. Hebrew lets you re-engage as an active parent — talk to teachers, help with homework. Real Success Stories from Our Students Sarah, 42, from New York — 18 months in Israel “I made aliyah with my husband and two kids. My kids picked up Hebrew in school in 6 months. I felt like a stranger in my own home. New School matched me with a teacher who specializes in adult olim from English-speaking countries. The MemoReach methodology — using my adult logic instead of childlike repetition — was transformational. After 8 months, I speak Hebrew at school meetings, with my doctor, even at parties. The 24/7 AI tutors made the difference: I practiced 15 minutes every day during my coffee break.” David, 28, from London — Software engineer at a Tel Aviv startup “My company works in English but team meetings often slip into Hebrew. I felt left out of jokes, side conversations, and team bonding. New School’s online course let me study after work. Within 4 months, I was confident enough to participate in informal team chats. By month 9, I was running parts of meetings in Hebrew. My manager noticed.” Rachel, 65, from Boston — Diaspora Jew planning to spend 6 months/year in Israel “I’m not making aliyah, but I want to live partially in Israel and feel at home. I tried Duolingo, books, even private tutors via Skype with mixed results. New School’s combination of a great human teacher PLUS the AI tutor on WhatsApp was magic. The AI never gets tired of my questions. The human teacher pushes me past my comfort zone.” Ready to Start Learning Hebrew? Talk to our team on WhatsApp — we’ll understand your goals and design a custom plan for you. No obligation. 📱 Send us a WhatsApp message Frequently Asked Questions How long does it take to become fluent in Hebrew? For an adult English speaker starting from zero with 2 lessons/week + daily AI tutor practice: basic conversation in 4-6 months, fluent conversation in 9-12 months, advanced/business level in 18-24 months. Faster if you’re in Israel and immersed daily. Do your teachers speak English? Yes! All our Hebrew teachers are fluent in English. We can teach 100% in English at the start, gradually transitioning to Hebrew as your level grows. Can I take classes if I’m not in Israel? Absolutely. Our online classes work from anywhere in the world. Most of our diaspora students are in the US, UK, Canada, and Australia. Time zones are accommodated. Do you offer intensive courses for short stays in Israel? Yes — we offer “Hebrew Immersion” packages designed for Birthright, Masa, gap year, and short stays. Daily lessons + AI tutors = rapid progress in 4-12 weeks. Are you a recognized Misrad HaKlita institution? New School currently does not participate in the Misrad HaKlita voucher program. Olim eligible for vouchers should contact public ulpanim that accept them. We offer private, customized programs designed for working adult olim with flexible scheduling. What does the course cost? rows.content: FAQ Contact MyINL en fr de lu Institut Courses Certificates Sproochentest Trainings Events Calendar Search: en fr de lu Institut Courses Certificates Sproochentest Trainings Events Calendar FAQ Contact MyINL Enter your search Search: About the Institut national des langues Luxembourg The Institut national des langues Luxembourg is a public centre for adult learning and certification of modern language skills. In a friendly environment of meeting and exchange, it offers opportunities for personal and professional development for the benefit of learners and all the communities with which it interacts. This organisation and its pedagogical orientation reflects the linguistic flexibility of Luxembourg, which not only has three administrative languages, but also hosts a wide variety of expatriates and a large number of cross-border workers. Your gateway to integration and personal development This linguistic melting pot naturally commits the institute to promoting multilingualism, contributing to the employability of people, facilitating social integration and intercultural exchange through languages, and training language teachers. With a nationwide presence, the INLL organises international language examinations and tests in collaboration with a network of partners. It is recognised as a national certification centre for regulated diplomas and certificates in the Luxembourg language. A centre of exchange and encounters The INLL provides a welcoming and interactive environment to extend the exchanges and dialogue created during the courses through a diversified agenda of events and meetings. Our upcoming events What we do The INLL is a public centre for modern language learning and certification, committed to promoting plurilingualism, facilitating social integration, contributing to people’s employability, facilitating intercultural exchange through languages and training staff. Discover all our language courses The INLL offers courses for adults in 13 languages: ArabicChineseDutchEnglishFrenchGermanItalianJapaneseKoreanLuxembourgishPortugueseRussianSpanish The range comprises: general language courses for beginners and non-beginners. courses with specific objectives, e.g. Deutsch für den Beruf, Business English, Deutsch für Juristen, Italian for the media, etc. training for Luxembourgish language-teaching (Zertifikat Lëtzebuergesch Léiere Léieren – ZLLL). Discover our language courses In 2016, the INLL received more than 13,000 registrations from some 130 nationalities and offered more than 55,000 learning hours. The Zertifikat Lëtzebuergesch Léiere Léieren (ZLLL) is offered at the Institut national des langues Luxembourg (INLL). This course is aimed at people who wish to train or improve their skills as a teacher of the Luxembourg language and literature in the field of adult education in municipalities or in a field regulated by law. We would be delighted to receive your application! They are suitable for beginners as well as advanced learners. We have a very intensive Czech course, a course with long-term progression and the popular Czech for Beginners or Czech for Complete Beginners courses. And if you already know some Czech but need to improve your skills, we also have the right solution for you. Home»Language School»Corporate Czech courses What forms of Czech lessons for companies do we offer? Individual Czech lessons In corporate lessons it is always important to choose the right format for the Czech course, i.e., whether you want to have individual or group lessons. Individual Czech lessons are a particularly ideal option in certain situations, for example, when several students with different levels of proficiency decide to take a Czech course, or when there is someone who is very busy and cannot adapt to the demands of the group. If you are considering choosing an individual course, you will get undeniable advantages: The lessons will be tailored to the specific student, and will therefore be enjoyable and very effective for them, as the teacher is dedicated to them and can focus on the particular weaknesses revealed in the lessons. At the same time it will be easy to arrange for possible alternative lessons when a student goes on holiday or on a business trip. Group Czech lessons In corporate education Czech is often taught in groups. Skrivanek continuously trains its lecturers in this regard, so that these lecturers are able to conduct group lessons in a lively and effective manner. Learning Czech in a reasonably small group has great advantages – for example, liveliness, the “natural learning” that comes from group communication, or the sharing of knowledge among students. In a group Czech course there are also more opportunities to simulate real-life situations, to include student dialogues or polls and other activities. The friendly, relaxed atmosphere in the group also has a strong positive effect on the retention and reinforcement of the acquired knowledge – it results from the fact that the teacher’s attention is evenly distributed among all participants and does not focus on one student all the time. Online Czech lessons Various online meetings have long been part of everyday working life, and so our tutors are also equipped to teach Czech online. Anyone who has ever tried it knows that online Czech lessons are just as effective as those in a classroom or conference room. Online lessons have undeniable advantages: There is no need to arrange a special space for group online learning. Furthermore, individual students can participate in the lesson even when they are away on business. It is also possible to make very good use of electronic learning materials. This will be useful, for example, for a company that may not have suitable IT equipment in the classroom or conference room. With Skrivanek’s online Czech lessons, students will experience the benefits of the online sphere: they can take full advantage of the various online quizzes and other activities offered by different Czech learning websites. They can be created for one “player” (in individual online Czech lessons) or for several participants (in group online Czech lessons). Face-to-face Czech lessons Face-to-face corporate Czech lessons have long been the gold standard. And yet this course format is still very popular. It’s only logical – it has many advantages. The Czech lessons will take place at your company premises. The teacher comes to your company and therefore saves your company and employees precious time. The day and time of the Czech lessons are of course based on your needs and the teacher will adapt to your time requirements. Teaching outside working hours is not an obstacle. In-person Czech lessons offer an unforgettable experience in the form of a personal meeting with the teacher. The supervisors of the studying employees also like this form of Czech lessons – they can be sure that the lessons are taking place, they can agree with the teacher on possible adjustments to the lesson plan and other minor changes, or they can sometimes monitor the progress of the studying employees. Language levels We offer Czech courses at all levels Czech A1 –⁠ complete beginner Czech A2 –⁠ beginner Czech B1 –⁠ moderately advanced Czech B2 –⁠ intermediate Czech C1 –⁠ very advanced Czech C2 –⁠ expert We want to teach our employees Czech Benefits of a company Czech course from Skrivanek Tailor-made lessons and an individual approach Effective and targeted Czech teaching Preparation for real-life situations Quality and professional Czech teachers First class customer service Czech lessons all over the Czech Republic What will you and your employees gain from a Czech course? They will gain confidence and shyness will disappear The Czech language course will help you and your employees overcome barriers in communication and gradually get rid of the shyness of speaking Czech. By improving your language skills, you will gain more confidence and comfort in communication, which can have a positive effect on professional presentation and interpersonal relationships. Improvement of company communication and teamwork Improving language skills in Czech will enable employees to better communicate with colleagues, superiors and customers. This will lead to a more efficient work environment and reduce potential misunderstandings. Employees who communicate in Czech can collaborate more easily in a team and share information and ideas more effectively. Better company image A company that invests in the language training of its employees creates the impression of consideration for the needs and comfort of its employees. This can have a positive effect on the company's reputation as an employer. Clients satisfied with their Czech lessons I am very happy with my teacher. Mirka adapts to what I need and keeps me motivated. She cares for her students and I can definitely see the progress since I started with her. A. E. I am very happy with the teacher. She is always very well prepared and present the class exceptionally. S. M. I have tried learning Czech before, but the way Sandra proceeds the class, the variety of class material, her attitude and attention towards the class that she teaches and towards me gives me the motivation to come to classes and continue learning this rather hard language. H. O. Petra is very good teacher always doing her best to keep me active to learn. D. T. Previous Next Complementary forms of Czech teaching Phone Czech lessons Phone lessons are ideal for those who are short on time, constantly on the move or in busy environments where it is difficult for them to concentrate fully for long periods of time. One phone “lesson” takes only ten minutes. However, because the lesson is perfectly prepared and because the lessons take place daily, your progress will be very real and long-lasting. More about phone lessons Do you need to improve the standard of Czech in your company? Maybe you or your employees are proficient in Czech, and maybe you just want to get started. Our teachers will be happy to work with you. To fulfill this, we aim to adhere as strictly as possible to the World Wide Web Consortium’s (W3C) Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.1 (WCAG 2.1) at the AA level. These guidelines explain how to make web content accessible to people with a wide array of disabilities. Complying with those guidelines helps us ensure that the website is accessible to all people: blind people, people with motor impairments, visual impairment, cognitive disabilities, and more. This website utilizes various technologies that are meant to make it as accessible as possible at all times. We utilize an accessibility interface that allows persons with specific disabilities to adjust the website’s UI (user interface) and design it to their personal needs. Additionally, the website utilizes an AI-based application that runs in the background and optimizes its accessibility level constantly. This application remediates the website’s HTML, adapts Its functionality and behavior for screen-readers used by the blind users, and for keyboard functions used by individuals with motor impairments. If you’ve found a malfunction or have ideas for improvement, we’ll be happy to hear from you. You can reach out to the website’s operators by using the following email Screen-reader and keyboard navigation Our website implements the ARIA attributes (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) technique, alongside various different behavioral changes, to ensure blind users visiting with screen-readers are able to read, comprehend, and enjoy the website’s functions. As soon as a user with a screen-reader enters your site, they immediately receive a prompt to enter the Screen-Reader Profile so they can browse and operate your site effectively. Here’s how our website covers some of the most important screen-reader requirements, alongside console screenshots of code examples: Screen-reader optimization: we run a background process that learns the website’s components from top to bottom, to ensure ongoing compliance even when updating the website. In this process, we provide screen-readers with meaningful data using the ARIA set of attributes. For example, we provide accurate form labels; descriptions for actionable icons (social media icons, search icons, cart icons, etc.); validation guidance for form inputs; element roles such as buttons, menus, modal dialogues (popups), and others. Additionally, the background process scans all the website’s images and provides an accurate and meaningful image-object-recognition-based description as an ALT (alternate text) tag for images that are not described. It will also extract texts that are embedded within the image, using an OCR (optical character recognition) technology. To turn on screen-reader adjustments at any time, users need only to press the Alt+1 keyboard combination. Screen-reader users also get automatic announcements to turn the Screen-reader mode on as soon as they enter the website. These adjustments are compatible with all popular screen readers, including JAWS and NVDA. Keyboard navigation optimization: The background process also adjusts the website’s HTML, and adds various behaviors using JavaScript code to make the website operable by the keyboard. This includes the ability to navigate the website using the Tab and Shift+Tab keys, operate dropdowns with the arrow keys, close them with Esc, trigger buttons and links using the Enter key, navigate between radio and checkbox elements using the arrow keys, and fill them in with the Spacebar or Enter key.Additionally, keyboard users will find quick-navigation and content-skip menus, available at any time by clicking Alt+1, or as the first elements of the site while navigating with the keyboard. The background process also handles triggered popups by moving the keyboard focus towards them as soon as they appear, and not allow the focus drift outside it. Users can also use shortcuts such as “M” (menus), “H” (headings), “F” (forms), “B” (buttons), and “G” (graphics) to jump to specific elements. Disability profiles supported in our website Epilepsy Safe Mode: this profile enables people with epilepsy to use the website safely by eliminating the risk of seizures that result from flashing or blinking animations and risky color combinations. Visually Impaired Mode: this mode adjusts the website for the convenience of users with visual impairments such as Degrading Eyesight, Tunnel Vision, Cataract, Glaucoma, and others. Cognitive Disability Mode: this mode provides different assistive options to help users with cognitive impairments such as Dyslexia, Autism, CVA, and others, to focus on the essential elements of the website more easily. ADHD Friendly Mode: this mode helps users with ADHD and Neurodevelopmental disorders to read, browse, and focus on the main website elements more easily while significantly reducing distractions. Blindness Mode: this mode configures the website to be compatible with screen-readers such as JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, and TalkBack. A screen-reader is software for blind users that is installed on a computer and smartphone, and websites must be compatible with it. Keyboard Navigation Profile (Motor-Impaired): this profile enables motor-impaired persons to operate the website using the keyboard Tab, Shift+Tab, and the Enter keys. Users can also use shortcuts such as “M” (menus), “H” (headings), “F” (forms), “B” (buttons), and “G” (graphics) to jump to specific elements. Additional UI, design, and readability adjustments Font adjustments – users, can increase and decrease its size, change its family (type), adjust the spacing, alignment, line height, and more. Color adjustments – users can select various color contrast profiles such as light, dark, inverted, and monochrome. Additionally, users can swap color schemes of titles, texts, and backgrounds, with over seven different coloring options. Animations – person with epilepsy can stop all running animations with the click of a button. Animations controlled by the interface include videos, GIFs, and CSS flashing transitions. Content highlighting – users can choose to emphasize important elements such as links and titles. They can also choose to highlight focused or hovered elements only. Audio muting – users with hearing devices may experience headaches or other issues due to automatic audio playing. This option lets users mute the entire website instantly. Cognitive disorders – we utilize a search engine that is linked to Wikipedia and Wiktionary, allowing people with cognitive disorders to decipher meanings of phrases, initials, slang, and others. Additional functions – we provide users the option to change cursor color and size, use a printing mode, enable a virtual keyboard, and many other functions. Browser and assistive technology compatibility We aim to support the widest array of browsers and assistive technologies as possible, so our users can choose the best fitting tools for them, with as few limitations as possible. Therefore, we have worked very hard to be able to support all major systems that comprise over 95% of the user market share including Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, Opera and Microsoft Edge, JAWS and NVDA (screen readers). Notes, comments, and feedback Despite our very best efforts to allow anybody to adjust the website to their needs. rows.content: Homepage Corporate About Us Contact YOUR PATH TO FLUENCY IN PORTUGUESE! Speak Portuguese with Confidence! Interactive lessons, expert guidance, and everything you need to master Portuguese at your own pace. You can choose for classes in English, French or SpanishWhy Choose PORTUGUESE4U?Customized Learning Experience: Regardless of your reason for learning Portuguese—be it for business, travel, studies, or personal interest, we create lessons around your specific objectives. Our approach is designed to fit your learning style, ensuring every class is both relevant and effective. Flexible Learning OptionsWe offer both 1-on-1 and group classes, available online or in-person. You choose the format that works best for you, allowing for a personalized experience from anywhere in the world or a more hands-on approach if you prefer in-person learning. Cultural Immersion at Its BestAt PORTUGUESE4U, language learning goes beyond textbooks. We immerse you in the rich, diverse culture of the Portuguese-speaking world through music, articles, videos, podcasts, and real conversations. By integrating these real-life materials, we make the learning experience more dynamic and relevant, helping you communicate naturally and confidently. Connecting People Through the Language of PortugueseDiscover the Joy of Learning Portuguese with Portuguese4u! Hello! My name is Homero Feijó. I’m a Brazilian Portuguese teacher for foreigners with over a decade of experience helping people from all over the world communicate confidently and naturally in Portuguese. Throughout my career, I’ve worked with CEOs of major companies, expatriates and their families, students, travelers, and lovers of the Portuguese language to help them achieve their goals—whether for work, study, or leisure. My lessons go far beyond grammar: they’re a cultural immersion. I use music, videos, articles, podcasts, and real conversations to create a practical, engaging, and personalized learning experience. Regardless of your Portuguese proficiency level, my goal is to make your learning journey enjoyable, captivating, efficient, and tailored to your interests and needs. Come learn Portuguese in a fun, engaging, and transformative way! Here, you will really find PORTUGUESE4U !!!Our Students Feedback“I first started taking lessons with Homero when I moved to Sao Paulo in 2015 to work in the Financial Industry. In my experience, It’s difficult to find really good teachers in life. If you feel the same way, I highly recommend that you try a class.” MAT Philosophy teacher USA Interactive lessons, expert guidance, and everything you need to master Portuguese at your own pace. Berlitz is proud to offer all Bright Horizons/EdAssist Network Clients a 15% discount off regular prices for all language training services and waived registration fees for all returning students.The most effective methodLanguage learning with Berlitz is an immersive experience.* The Berlitz Method was invented by our founder in 1878 and is still the most effective language learning technique used today.Your lessons are conducted in the target language from day one and each activity focuses on a specific learning goal tailored to your needs.Language is presented in the context of real-life situations, and rather than academic translations or grammar rules, we focus on the language skills you will need to navigate daily interactions. This allows you to gain confidence in actually using the language, rather than focusing on non-speaking skills.Your instructor guides you through a process of practice and presentation to help you quickly absorb what you’ve learned and progress to the next level.About BerlitzWho We AreBerlitz is dedicated to improving people’s lives globally through language and culture. As a global leader in quality language, communication, and cultural training, we are committed to your success. Through our global network, the trusted Berlitz Method®, customizable instruction options, and experienced instructors, Berlitz consistently achieves our goal of producing successful and confident customers.What we believe inThe most effective way of learning is learning from people and with people.Intercultural competencies are key to successful communication in a global environment.Immediate results and constant progress drive motivation and self-confidence.Only by acquiring relevant skills can people become self-confident and unleash their full potential in life.Our passion and commitment to client goal achievement engenders trust.Berlitz Learning CycleThe Berlitz Learning Cycle ensures you are always on track to achieving your specific language goals. With dedicated instructors and academic specialists, you have an entire team committed to your success and will guide you through your language journey.How does it work?To start, we assess your needs, goals, and language proficiency to identify a great starting level. Your course is adapted to suit your individual learning style and objectives. As you progress through your program, you will receive regular feedback and guidance to keep you motivated and moving forward! At the end of your course, a final level check and certificate of achievement will mark your accomplishment.Berlitz Levels of ProficiencyAll Berlitz language programs have standardized proficiency levels, which allow you to measure and track your progress. We determine your current proficiency level before you begin your course, and as you progress, we assess your skills before advancing to the next level.Functional AbilityLevel 1:Knowledge of language is sufficient to communicate in a very limited way, with the simplest oral and listening tasks and situations.Level 2:At the functional level, you have a basic command of the language needed in a limited range of simple, routine, and familiar tasks and situations.Intermediate AbilityLevel 3:You can handle most uncomplicated communicative tasks and routine social and work situations. You can follow the general meaning of a conversation about familiar subjects.Level 4:At the intermediate level, you are able to refashion and combine learned material to meet your immediate communication and learning needs. You can comprehend information on familiar topics in contextualized settings and produce sustained conversation with others on an expanding variety of general topics.Upper Intermediate AbilityLevel 5:You can, to an extent, initiate, sustain and conclude most routine communicative tasks for personal and work needs.Level 6:At the upper intermediate level, you have assimilated the essentials of the language. You can communicate competently and comfortably in many professional and personal contexts and can find different ways of formulating what you want to express.Advanced AbilityLevel 7:You begin to create with the language in more complex, cognitively demanding situations, and in conversations, and can deal comfortably with most subjects over the telephone.Level 8:At the advanced level, you communicate effectively and appropriately even in demanding oral tasks and situations, like conducting a meeting. You can participate easily in social and professional conversations and can deal comfortably with most subjects over the telephone.Professional AbilityLevel 9:You communicate effectively with various audiences on a wide range of familiar and new topics to meet most personal, academic, or professional demands—including many which presume experience in public speaking and critical listening.Level 10:At the professional level, you have full command of the language. You understand and can use virtually all linguistic structures as well as a range of vocabulary items as broad and deep as that of most educated native speakers. Communication is fluent, appropriate, and well organized—you develop ideas in speech clearly and coherently.Advantages of Class FrequencyThe most effective way to learn a new language is with frequent, immersive blocks of instruction, rather than instruction spread out over a long period of time.Intensive program schedules enable you to reach your goals quicker! You spend less time reviewing concepts you covered in your last lesson, and more time building your language skills.We value your time and want to ensure you achieve your goals as quickly and efficiently as possible.Approved ProgramsPrivate Instruction OnlineLearn a language at your own pace when it's convenient for you. Private Instruction Online offers maximum flexibilityOne-on-one learning with a highly trained, native fluent Berlitz instructor using conversational Berlitz Method.Learn at home, in the office or on the go.Convenient, flexible scheduling.Includes 24/7 access to online review materials.Available for all languages.Each language level consist of 40, 45 minute sessions.Request this courseGroup Instruction OnlineLearning a new language online with a small group of peers. Enjoy the camaraderie and fun of learning a new language together!Perfect for beginners and intermediate students.Small classes size (2-6 students) encourages social interaction and practice.Program consists of 40, one-hour lessons.Convenient schedules, meet twice weekly for one hour for 20 weeks.Follows the renowned Berlitz Methodology and curriculum across all levels.Request this courseOnline, Self-Paced learning with Live InstructionBerlitz Flex - The most flexible way to learn a new language efficiently: self-paced learning, speech recognition and regular live, online private lessons with an instructor.Speech recognition gives you immediate feedback to gain confidence speaking faster.Includes 20, 25-minute coaching sessions with a Berlitz Instructor.Follow a structured learning plan that aligns with the Berlitz levels to measurably improve your skills.Available for English, Spanish, German, and French.12 or 6 - 6-month subscription, “All You Can Learn” - Unlimited Levels.Request this courseOnline, Self-Paced Language Learning SolutionBerlitz On Demand – The industry’s most advanced self-paced language learning solution with cutting-edge speech recognition, AI technology and interactive videos. Rosetta Stone for EnterpriseFactors to consider when choosing a business Korean courseTutors’ experience and originsFlexibilityCustomizationSupport and account managementFrequently asked questionsWhy learn Korean for business?Why choose business Korean courses?Take learning business Korean to the next level with Preply Picture this: You’re in a meeting where half the room is nodding along, while the other half looks lost. The Korean team lead is explaining a new project, but her English-speaking colleagues struggle to follow. Someone attempts to translate, but the nuances get lost, and the meeting takes double the time it was supposed to. Fast forward to the company dinner, and an English-speaking colleague accidentally offends his Korean coworker by being too casual. Cue the awkward silence and uncomfortable smiles. By the end of the night, you’ve got little language groups forming. Korean speakers here, English speakers there—and some people feel left out of the conversation entirely. The right business Korean language course can help you avoid situations like these. It boosts teamwork between international colleagues, helps prevent cultural mix-ups, and gives your employees the confidence to work across borders. This is crucial whether you’re expanding to Korea, merging with a Korean company, or moving staff to Seoul. To help save you the trouble of researching everything yourself, let’s explore four of the best business Korean courses on the market. 4 Top business Korean classes and online courses Below, you’ll find a breakdown of all four programs and what your people will learn in each one. Short on time? Here’s a summary: Preply Business: Best for teams needing a fully customizable, online 1:1 tutoring program ELT Korean for Business: Best for teams needing in-person group classes or intensive Korean lessons Lexis Korea: Best for teams who already have a presence in Seoul or Busan Rosetta Stone for Enterprise: Best for teams looking for online, 1:1 tutoring up to B1 level 💡 Note: The pricing for all the programs below is tailored to your specific needs and company size. For an exact quote, request a demo or reach out to sales. 1. Preply Business Preply’s corporate Korean training focuses on improving employees’ language and communication skills through personalized, online 1:1 tutoring. Lessons can be tailored to each employee’s role—whether they’re in sales, customer service, or management—ensuring everyone gets the most relevant and impactful language training. For example, sales teams can practice negotiation skills in Korean. While customer service reps can learn how to handle inquiries politely and managers are taught to give feedback using appropriate honorifics. Plus, with over 800 Korean tutors on the platform, you can easily find the perfect match for your team’s specific learning preferences and schedules. As a bonus, you can quickly scale up your language training program as your team grows or your international operations expand. Finally, you’ll have access to a corporate dashboard where you can track the progress and engagement of your people and analyze how effective the training is for your organization. And if you ever need help, our 24/7 support team is here to guide you through setting up and managing Korean language classes for your team. What you’ll learn Our business Korean program covers a comprehensive range of skills, including written and verbal communication, business writing, presentation skills, and industry-specific vocabulary. The exact lessons depend on what your employees need. They’ll work with their tutor and our team to make a learning plan that fits their goals and your company’s needs. For example, employees might learn about Korean workplace cultures, like how to speak politely to coworkers and clients, what to do at business dinners or the right way to exchange business cards. 2. Executive Language Training (ELT) Korean for business ELT offers in-person and online Korean classes for all language levels—from beginner to advanced. And with a global client list like Heinz and Walmart, they have experience in helping large companies overcome language barriers and improve international communication. With in-person classes, you can arrange for a tutor to come onsite for private or group lessons. For example, you could set up group classes for whole departments or different language levels. Or you might choose individual classes for your executives who need focused attention. ELT also offers intensive Korean language classes that range from one to four weeks in duration. For example, if your management team has a trip to Korea coming up in a month, you can sign them up for a two-week crash course to prepare them for important meetings and cultural interactions. What you’ll learn ELT tutors teach industry-specific Korean. They focus on everyday vocabulary, expressions, and phrases important for business, and even use role-play exercises to practice real-world situations. For beginners, classes cover speaking, listening, writing, reading comprehension, and grammar building. For advanced learners, there’s more immersion and conversation with native speakers. Depending on your teacher, you can even practice with real-life materials like news clips, advertisements, and TV shows in Korean. 3. Lexis Korea Lexis Korea is a language academy with schools in Seoul and Busan. They offer general, business, or specialist language programs to help employees conduct business in Korean as well as understand Korean culture. As the institution is based in South Korea, it’s perfect for government organizations, education institutions, or international businesses that already have a presence in the country. But Lexis also offers online classes for international businesses or employees who aren’t yet based in Korea. Classes are held in small groups or 1:1 sessions and can be highly customized to meet your company’s specific needs. Finally, Lexis Korea’s corporate training program provides flexible schedules so even if your employees have busy workdays, they can still fit in language learning at times that work for them. For example, in the evenings or on the weekends. What you’ll learn Like the other programs on this list, Lexis Korea’s corporate training program is highly customizable. So you can tailor the content to your company’s specific needs and goals. But in general, this school’s courses consist of a mixed approach, covering core components of the Korean language and its practical use in business settings. Lexis Korea also offers classes on cultural topics like Korean cooking, general etiquette, and even K-pop dance. So your employees can gain a deeper understanding of Korean culture alongside their language skills. 4. Rosetta Stone for Enterprise Rosetta Stone for Enterprise combines self-guided web-based and in-app exercises and lessons with unlimited live tutoring. This flexible learning style means your teams can study whenever is most convenient for them. But also access live tutoring to ask questions, practice speaking, and clarify any confusing points. Like Preply Business, Rosetta Stone’s program offers reporting and analytics tools. These help you track your team’s progress, showing performance metrics like completed lessons, test scores, and tutoring sessions attended. However, the program’s Korean course only covers from beginner to the B1 level on the CEFR scale. This is Rosetta Stone’s Foundations program. It’s a good choice for employees who mainly need to understand and respond to basic written tasks, manage routine situations at work, follow a simple presentation, and answer questions on a familiar topic. Industry and career-specific content is introduced at a higher level, in the Rosetta Stone Fluency Builder program. Which isn’t available for Korean at this time. What you’ll learn With Rosetta Stone, employees start by learning words through images, then build up to sentences and phrases. This method helps learners develop vocabulary, understand grammar naturally, and gain an intuitive feel for Korean language structure. They’ll also complete different exercises focused on grammar, reading and comprehension, listening, and speaking. Rosetta Stone also gauges your people’s pronunciation by using a speech recognition tool to compare learners’ pronunciation with that of native speakers. Factors to consider when choosing a business Korean course Tutors’ experience and origins Working with native Korean speakers from the region your business operates in will make the biggest impact on your employees’ knowledge of local customs. Besides teaching the local dialect, these tutors can give insights into the culture, such as formal and informal greetings and when to use them. Flexibility Adding an extra commute to your employees’ schedules could make them feel disgruntled about learning a new language. By choosing a flexible option, you can ensure your employees have the freedom to attend their classes where and when they want. This way, it’s more likely that they’ll look forward to their next Korean language class. Customization Mnemonic devices, language buddies, immersion — all of these are scientifically proven ways of learning a language. But you also need the right teacher who’ll know which technique to use with different learners. Customizable courses and 1-on-1 tutoring provide you with teachers who’ll tailor the content and teaching style to each of your employees. Support and account management The customer support and account management teams of language training programs solve more than technical issues. They can match you with the right tutors based on your needs and help your HR team make the most out of the platform’s tools. They’ll help your learners remain engaged and administrators get top-notch service. Frequently asked questions Why learn Korean for business? South Korea is a notable player in the global economy. It’s the 14th largest economy in the world and the 4th largest in Asia according to the IMF. It’s also home to tech giants like Samsung and Hyundai, and one of the world’s main producers of electronics, semiconductors, and cars. By investing in Korean language skills, your organization can better tap into this market. Plus, while English is often the default B2B language for organizations, Korean language skills can truly set your teams apart. It shows dedication, cultural sensitivity, and a long-term commitment to the Korean market. This can open doors to partnerships, collaborations, and business opportunities that might otherwise remain closed to companies relying solely on English. Why choose business Korean courses? Business Korean courses are designed specifically for the workplace, teaching you not just the language, but also important business etiquette and cultural nuances. In Korean business culture, for example, using the right level of formality is a must. A good course will teach you how to address colleagues and clients properly, avoiding potential embarrassment or offense. For example, while in countries like the UK and the US, addressing a client by their first name is accepted and sometimes even preferred, in Korea, it’s considered very disrespectful. Business Korean courses also focus on industry-specific terminology that you won’t find in general language apps or textbooks. Whether you’re in tech, finance, or manufacturing, the right course teaches you the words and phrases most relevant to your field. Take learning business Korean to the next level with Preply The right Korean business course for your organization depends on factors like your team’s needs, budget, and learning goals. You need to consider what your organization wants to achieve, but also what will help keep your team engaged and learning actively. Flexibility is an important factor. The best Korean business program adapts to your people and their schedules. Not the other way around. Preply’s corporate language training lets employees learn business Korean online and on their own time. Lessons are available around the clock, regardless of time zones. Plus, our carefully selected, expert tutors tailor classes to your employees’ needs and unique learning styles. So your team can learn at their own pace and in a way that works best for them. Preply also gives you access to a corporate dashboard, letting you see how your teams are progressing. So you always have your finger on the pulse of the program’s effectiveness. And if things aren’t going the way you’d hoped, you always have access to a dedicated account manager to help adjust the plan. Ensure 18% faster results than global standards with Preply.
