rows.content: Skip to main content Skip to footer Renting Out Your Home Homes for Rent For property investors Guide to Renting Out About us Contact DA Renting Out Your Home Homes for Rent For property investors Guide to Renting Out About us Contact DA Your browser does not support the video tag.Corporate housing in Denmark – quality homes for your expat employeesFinding the right home for a relocating employee is time-consuming, stressful and full of legal complexity. Home Connector handles everything — from sourcing and screening properties to contracts, move-in inspections and ongoing management. Trusted by HR teams and relocation bureaus across Denmark for over 15 years.Talk to our corporate teamSee how it works(4,8 on Trustpilot)Trusted by 200+ landlords across DenmarkOur clients typically own between 100 and 2,000 rental properties.Our network of companies is unique and makes a significant difference for our clients’ high-end properties. We have rented out homes to employees from, among others.What is corporate housing and why does it matter?Corporate housing refers to fully or partially furnished residential properties rented by companies or their employees for temporary or long-term stays – typically in connection with international assignments, project postings or permanent relocations. For HR departments and relocation bureaus, finding and managing corporate housing in Denmark comes with significant challenges: navigating Danish tenancy law, sourcing quality properties in high-demand areas, managing contracts and move-in documentation, and ensuring the employee settles in smoothly. Home Connector was built to solve exactly this. We act as the single point of contact between your organisation and the Danish rental market – handling every step so your HR team can focus on the employee, not the paperwork. Quality-screened propertiesEvery property in our portfolio is personally assessed. We match your employee’s needs: location, size, furnished or unfurnished, schools nearby – with the right home. Full legal complianceDanish tenancy law is complex. We handle contracts, deposit management and move-in inspections in full compliance – protecting both the employer and the employee. Fast turnaroundWe maintain an active network of landlords who rent specifically to corporate tenants. We can often present options within 24–48 hours of your enquiry. Your browser does not support the video tag.Why HR teams and relocation bureaus choose Home ConnectorThere are several agencies operating in the Danish rental market. Here is what sets Home Connector apart – particularly for corporate clients. 1. Denmark’s largest corporate tenant network We have direct daily contact with relocation bureaus, HR departments and corporate housing managers at some of Denmark’s and the world’s largest companies. When a property becomes available, our corporate clients hear first – before it goes to market. 2. 15+ years of specialist experience Home Connector was founded in 2009 with a clear focus: quality rentals for international professionals. Every process, every contract template and every screening procedure has been refined over thousands of placements. 3. Single point of contact Your HR team deals with one person at Home Connector. Not a platform, not a ticket system – a named contact who knows your organisation’s preferences and handles everything end to end. 4. Rated 4.8 on Trustpilot We are one of Denmark’s highest-rated rental agencies on Trustpilot. Our reputation is built on making the rental process smooth for both landlords and tenants – which means fewer problems for your organisation. Create more value in your rentalWhat we do for your organisationOur corporate housing service covers the complete rental journey — from the initial housing brief to the final move-out inspection. 1. HOUSING NEEDS ASSESSMENT We start with a detailed brief – location preferences, commute requirements, budget, lease length, furnished or unfurnished, family size and any specific requirements. We match against our active portfolio and network. 2. PROPERTY SOURCING AND PRESENTATION We present a curated shortlist of suitable properties with full documentation. Your employee or HR team reviews and selects – we handle all follow-up with landlords. 3. TENENCY CONTRACTS AND LEGAL COMPLIANCE We draft or review all tenancy contracts in compliance with Danish tenancy law (Lejeloven). Deposits, pre-paid rent, lease terms and termination clauses are all handled correctly from day one. 4. MOVE-IN INSPECTION AND DOCUMENTATION We conduct a professional move-in inspection with full photographic documentation before your employee takes possession. This protects both parties and forms the legal basis for the move-out settlement. 5. ONGOING TENANT SUPPORT Throughout the tenancy, Home Connector serves as the primary contact point for your employee. Day-to-day questions, maintenance coordination and communication with the landlord – we handle it all. 6. MOVE-OUT INSPECTION AND DEPOSIT SETTLEMENT When the assignment ends, we conduct the move-out inspection, compare against the move-in documentation and handle the deposit settlement in accordance with Danish law. We respond within 24 hours 2We activate our network Before advertising publicly, we contact our direct network of corporate-friendly landlords. Many placements are made before a property is ever listed. 3Property presentation and selection We present a shortlist of suitable options with full details and photos. Your employee or HR team selects their preferred property. 4Contract, inspection and move-in We handle the tenancy contract, conduct the move-in inspection with full documentation and coordinate key handover. Your employee is ready to move in. 5Ongoing support and move-out We remain the point of contact throughout the tenancy and manage the full move-out process when the assignment ends. Should we be responsible for operations?Where we operateWe specialise in corporate housing placements in the areas where demand for international talent is highest. CopenhagenOur primary market. We cover all major residential areas favoured by expat professionals – Østerbro, Frederiksberg, Hellerup, Gentofte, Nordhavn and the city centre. We know which neighbourhoods suit different employee profiles and family situations. North ZealandMany international employees – particularly those with families – prefer the quieter residential areas of North Zealand. We have strong coverage of Hellerup, Charlottenlund, Lyngby, Gentofte, Vedbæk and surrounding areas, often close to international schools. AarhusWe cover corporate housing placements in Aarhus and the surrounding area. Demand is growing as more international companies establish operations in Denmark’s second city. Ready to simplify employee housing in Denmark?Tell us about your organisation’s housing needs. We’ll get back to you within 24 hours with a concrete proposal – and a dedicated contact for your account. No obligation · Response within 24 hours · Dedicated account contact Contact our corporate team Call usFrequently Asked QuestionsDo you manage properties outside Copenhagen and Aarhus?Yes — we work with property investors across all of Denmark, including Odense, Aalborg, Funen, Southern Jutland and the rest of the country. Our corporate tenant network is national. Contact us with your specific properties and locations and we will give you an honest assessment. Can you handle a full project letting and multiple units simultaneously?Yes. Project letting is one of our core competencies. We have managed simultaneous multi-unit lettings for residential developments across Denmark — coordinating marketing, viewings, screening and move-ins for multiple properties in parallel. Contact us early in your development timeline to plan the letting strategy. What does facility management typically include?Our facility management covers grounds maintenance (lawn, gardens, outdoor areas), snow clearing and gritting, stairwell and common area cleaning, coordination of repair contractors, and management of minor maintenance issues. The exact scope is agreed per property or portfolio. We can combine facility management with our letting and administration service for a fully comprehensive arrangement. How is pricing structured for portfolio clients?For portfolio clients we typically work on a framework agreement with agreed fee structures covering letting fees (from 3.500 DKK pr. rental), administration and facility management separately. This gives you cost predictability across your portfolio. Contact us to discuss what would work for your specific situation. Can you take over management of properties that are already tenanted?Yes. We regularly take on management of existing tenancies, reviewing contracts, updating documentation and assuming the ongoing administration and tenant contact. We conduct a full portfolio review at onboarding to identify any gaps or issues in existing tenancy documentation. We also secure every transaction with passcodes and Face ID or Touch ID technology, as well as confirm every customer’s identity when opening an account. Learn more about our security here.What documents do I need to open an account?You’ll need government-issued ID, for example, a passport. You'll also need a smartphone to use your account, and must be a resident of a country we operate in.How much does it cost to open an account?The N26 Standard bank account is free and there are no opening or maintenance fees. N26 Smart costs €4.90 per month, N26 Go costs €9.90 per month, and N26 Metal is €16.90 per month. No deposit or minimum income is required to open an account.How do I send money abroad with N26?Sending money abroad with N26 is simple and intuitive. You can choose from a variety of different transfer types — from bank transfers and SWIFT payments to debit or credit card transfers, and much more — for a low, transparent fee. You’ll be guided through the steps to complete your transfer the quick and easy way.Do I need a Wise account to send money abroad with my N26 account?You don’t need a Wise account to send money internationally, as we’ve has partnered with Wise so you can make foreign currency transfers directly in the N26 app.How long does it take for the money to reach the recipient’s bank account?Some payments will be processed instantly, and most will be completed in one business day. Reach out about international employment taxes Meet the team David Purse Head of Payroll and Employment Taxes Contact David How we help Payroll Global Mobility Remote Worker Support Expatriate & UK Tax Compliance Employee Benefits Systems & Software Global Tax Planning HELPING YOU WITH INTERNATIONAL EMPLOYMENT TAXES International businesses are increasingly reaping the benefits of global mobility, hiring talented people working in overseas markets and relocating or assigning key UK employees to foreign territories. Many of these organisations are also outsourcing and offshoring their core payroll, HR and finance functions. Whilst there are many advantages to this outsourcing, it can also make it complex and time-consuming to ensure you comply with employment taxes globally. We recognise and resolve these issues, by bringing together a globally coordinated network of specialists and market leading technology, to help you effectively manage international employment taxes in all jurisdictions. All coordinated by AAB, and with us as your single point of contact. Speak with us today RECOGNISING & RESOLVING ISSUES Moving your core employment and payroll functions to a globally centralised and lower-cost environment has obvious attractions, but can also present some significant drawbacks: Complex processes are often overly simplified in a shared service centre environment, leading to compliance exposures and risk. Outsourcing and globalising local country processes (such as overseas payroll) can lead to a gap in the skills and knowledge needed to manage off-cycle and non-standard items locally, to identify and escalate potential risk issues and to manage the impact of business change. Geographical separation from the core business can mean the compliance processing function is disconnected from the business, and consequently oversight and visibility are lost. Our international employment tax service helps eliminate these risks whilst still providing a cost-efficient response. Find out about our services LOCAL KNOWLEDGE ACCESSED GLOBALLY Through our UK-based employment and tax experts and their affiliate counterparts in key locations around the world, we provide a joined-up, easily accessible service. This includes: Global employment tax compliance and advice. Local knowledge, globally, from our worldwide strategic partners to support tax compliance in overseas locations. Advice on HMRC administrative concessions to mitigate double taxation and aid cash flow. Tax policy preparation for expatriate employee populations. Implementation of expatriate tax processes and procedures. Net of tax credit schemes. Hypothetical tax calculations and reconciliations. Modified PAYE/NIC. Employment tax planning. Interaction with expatriate tax compliance requirements. Find out more KEEPING YOU IN TOUCH A major challenge with offshoring your global employment and tax compliance functions is the risk of disconnect between your UK HQ and your remote service operations. You don’t need to know the daily minutiae, but you do need to understand how major legislative changes will impact you – with advice on how to address them. In practice, this means we will: Monitor any changes in relevant employment legislation where you operate. Explain how these changes affect compliance. Deal with any queries raised by overseas tax authorities. Fully manage specific projects relating to legislation changes or case law outcomes. Collaborate with our Payroll and UK Employment Tax teams to address complex issues and create the right strategies for you. Support you in new locations and provide practical advice to help you set up more quickly and confidently. Get overseas support THINKING ALIKE By choosing us to help manage your international employment taxes, you’ll have the reassurance of working with a company that understands your operations and expectations. We integrate with your business culture to make communication straightforward and simpler – in a way that most offshoring service companies can never deliver. We also work around the multiple time zones covered by your global operations, to deliver answers when you want them, in person if you wish. Our team uses technology to speed up and simplify the exchange of critical information and provide the clarity and efficiency you seek. Above all, we’ll be consistently effective, handling your global responsibilities with a professional and personable approach. Have a chat about our comprehensive service AAB have helped a lot with us getting our accounts on track and helping our new accounts team. Anytime we need help or are querying something they are on the other side of the phone or are able to come in to the office to help us. We have seen real benefits in the quality and timeliness of our information. John Bannerman AAB help to relieve the burden of tax compliance and can be relied upon to deliver a high quality computation in an efficient manner. They can always be relied on to keep us up to date with changes in the legislation that will affect us. Home » Corporate Relocation Services for International Talent » Home finding support for international employees When it comes to relocating employees to Sweden for work, one of their first and most fundamental questions is often: “Where will I live?” The living environment is often one of the most significant aspects of the entire relocation,- and immigration process. For you as an employer, it’s not just about providing shelter but creating a safe place for comfort and success, both within and beyond the workplace. Contact us At Nimmersion, we offer a comprehensive housing service that eliminates the time-consuming tasks of finding a new home. We have a wide range of housing options and a close collaboration with landlords, enabling us to offer accommodations in various areas, from peaceful residential neighborhoods to vibrant urban settings. Welcome to Nimmersion, where we are dedicated to making your relocation and immigration as smooth and effortless as possible, no matter where your employee is in the world! Contact us Whether your employees are on their way to Sweden or returning from distant locations, Nimmersion is your reliable partner to make the entire relocation process straightforward and stress-free. Welcome to Nimmersion, where we are dedicated to making your relocation and immigration as smooth and effortless as possible, no matter where your employee is in the world! Parts Of Our Process 1. Initial Consultation 2. Searching for Housing 3. Contract Drafting and Negotiation 4. Key Handover and Practical Arrangements The housing process begins with an introductory meeting with you as the client and your newly hired talent. During this meeting, we walk through the entire housing search process to find the best accommodation for your employee. Following the initial meeting, we commence our search for residences that align with your specific preferences. Our search process is meticulous and aligned with your and employees preferences. We also arrange housing tours in person or via video. Once the prospective tenant has selected a residence they are satisfied with, we handle the negotiation and contract drafting process. Before the individual moves into the residence, we conduct a meticulous move-in inspection. After ensuring everything is in order, we provide the keys to the tenant and inform them about all practical aspects of their new accommodation. Our commitment goes beyond moving in; we also assist with practical arrangements such as home insurance.This is just a sample of what we offer in our Home Finding Service. Please don’t hesitate to contact us and provide more details about your specific situation. We can then offer you more comprehensive information about our entire process. About EN FR EN Get a callback Home Blog Best Paris Relocation Agencies: Find the Right Local Support Before Moving Expats 10min read Best Paris Relocation Agencies: Find the Right Local Support Before Moving A practical guide to choosing a relocation agency in Paris in 2026, covering what criteria matter, how agencies compare, and what fees to expect. Menu Table of contents Quick Answer Introduction What Defines a Strong Paris Relocation Agency Best Paris Relocation Agencies in 2026: Finding the Right Assist Why Paris Rentals Are More Competitive Than You Expect How Much Does a Paris Relocation Agency Cost? Corporate Relocation in Paris: What HR Teams Should Know FAQs Conclusion Author Élodie Garnier Relocation Expert Published on May 25, 2026 Quick Answer Paris relocation agencies handle property search, dossier preparation, off-market access, and lease review, so your application is ready before most listings go public.The Paris rental market runs at a 1-2% vacancy rate. A strong rental file and early access to properties are what determine outcomes.Agency fees typically range from €1,500 to €2,500 for a search-to-key-handover service.Not all Paris agencies have genuine off-market access or legal expertise. Verified reviews, transparent pricing, and a clear service scope are the right filters.The right agency reduces months of failed searching to a matter of weeks. Introduction The Paris rental market in 2026 has a vacancy rate of approximately 1-2%, a figure consistently tracked by ANIL, the national housing information agency. For international renters arriving with a corporate contract, a diplomatic posting, or a family move, this figure has one practical consequence: apartments at the right price and location are claimed quickly, often within days of listing.French landlords receive multiple applications simultaneously and assess each one based on income stability, documentation clarity, and guarantor arrangements. Foreign applicants, in most cases, arrive without the payslip format, guarantor options, or market knowledge that French landlords expect. This is not a structural disadvantage. It is an information gap that an experienced relocation agency closes before the first visit.A relocation agency in Paris does more than locate available apartments. It structures your search around your profile, prepares your dossier in the format that French agencies and landlords can read immediately, and accesses off-market properties not visible on Seloger or LeBonCoin. For expats managing a move from abroad, this combination of network access and file preparation can determine whether the search takes two weeks or four months.This guide explains what to look for when choosing a Paris relocation agency, how the main options compare in 2026, and what to expect in terms of costs and service scope. What Defines a Strong Paris Relocation Agency A relocation agency is only as useful as its network, its legal knowledge, and its ability to present your file clearly to Paris landlords. The criteria below separate agencies that deliver results from those that charge for introductions to public listings.Off-market access and what it means in practiceOff-market access in the Paris context means direct relationships with proprietary agents, private landlords, and building managers who offer properties before or outside public platforms. In a market where a well-priced furnished two-bedroom in the 7th or 8th arrondissement can receive 20 to 30 applications within 48 hours of listing, early access is not a service feature. It is how a competitive search works.An agency with genuine off-market relationships shortlists properties that match your profile before they reach Seloger or LeBonCoin. This is harder than it sounds, because maintaining those relationships requires consistent, daily presence in the Paris rental ecosystem, not just a subscription to aggregator platforms.One-advisor model versus team-based serviceSome agencies route clients through different departments at different stages. You speak to one person for the search, another for the lease, and another for the administrative setup. In a process where speed and coherence matter, this creates friction.A one-advisor model means your specific needs, timeline, and profile are held by a single person from the initial brief to key handover. The information does not need to be retransmitted at every stage. For clients managing a move remotely, this distinction matters more than it may seem at first. Paris relocation consultant reviewing rental dossier with expat client 2026 Verified reviews and legal expertiseTestimonials on an agency's own website are one signal. Cross-platform reviews on Google and Trustpilot are stronger ones, because they are harder to curate. Look for volume as well as score, recent reviews that describe the process specifically, and evidence that the agency has handled profiles similar to yours: international income, foreign payslips, remote searches from abroad.Legal expertise matters for a different reason. An agency that audits rent compliance before you sign protects you from paying above the loyer de référence majoré set by Paris rent control rules. That figure is updated annually by prefectural decree (currently the arrêté n°2025-06-16-00003, valid July 2025 to June 2026). An agency that does not know the current encadrement des loyers schedule is not protecting your interests during lease review. Best Paris Relocation Agencies in 2026: Finding the Right Assist Several agencies operate in the Paris market in 2026, with genuinely different service models, pricing structures, and areas of expertise. Matching the agency to your actual relocation profile matters more than choosing based on name recognition alone.Relocation in Paris Relocation in Paris We operate on a one-advisor model. From your initial brief to key handover, one advisor manages your search, dossier preparation, off-market access, visit coordination, lease compliance review, and installation. There are no handoffs between departments, and no reliance on public listing platforms. Every search is built from scratch around your profile, your timeline, and your criteria.If you are relocating from New York, London, Sydney, or anywhere you cannot visit in person, our Confié package is built for that situation. We attend visits on your behalf, send you structured video reports, and advance only the properties that genuinely match your brief. You receive the keys without having had to be in Paris for any of it.We are an official GarantMe partner, which means your guarantor solution is integrated into the application process rather than left to you to arrange separately. We also hold direct expertise in civil code leases for executives and senior professionals on company-funded accommodation above €5,000/month. Our rating stands at 4.9/5 across more than 375 Google reviews, with verified testimonials from clients who relocated remotely from New York, London, and Sydney.Key services:Property search with off-market access, not available on public portalsDossier preparation and optimisation for international income profilesVisit coordination, including remote-compatible video reports on your behalfLease compliance review against Paris rent control reference valuesComplete installation and administrative coordination (Confié package)Pricing:Accompagné (€1,500): property search, off-market access, dossier preparation, application managementConfié (€2,500): full service from search to key handover, every step handled on your behalfSuited to:Professionals relocating remotely from the US, UK, or anywhere outside FranceExecutives and senior professionals on corporate or civil code lease arrangementsFamilies needing school enrolment coordination alongside the housing searchDiplomats and embassy staff requiring lease flexibility and full discretionSmart RelocationSmart Relocation is a multilingual agency with coverage across France, not only Paris. Its particular strength is in administrative support beyond housing: healthcare enrollment, tax assistance, and family integration. It suits corporate assignments requiring coordination across multiple French cities, or clients who need structured post-settlement support alongside the housing search.Your Friend in ParisYour Friend in Paris has an active blog and a settling-in focus, with particular strength in family relocation and cultural orientation. It is well-suited for families new to France who want guidance beyond the housing process, including school search support and daily life preparation.Paris AttitudeParis Attitude manages a portfolio of more than 4,000 properties across Paris and Île-de-France. It is a volume-oriented option for corporate accounts that need to house multiple employees simultaneously under a standardised process with HR reporting.The French WayThe French Way is an FNPR-certified agency with strength in visa and administrative services across all of France. It is a practical option for clients who need housing support combined with immigration paperwork, driving license exchange, or healthcare setup, particularly for moves outside Paris or for clients arriving without an employer sponsor. Moving to Paris? Your Search, Handled End to End Off-market access, dossier preparation, lease review, and full installation. One advisor, no handoffs. Get a callback Why Paris Rentals Are More Competitive Than You Expect The Paris rental market does not have a supply problem in the abstract. It has a structured mismatch between what is available and what well-qualified renters, especially international ones, can actually access.Supply constraints:DPE Class G properties have been removed from the rental market since January 2025, reducing already-limited stockRent control under the encadrement des loyers keeps reference values below market asking prices, making landlords more selective about who they acceptCentral arrondissements (6e, 7e, 8e, 16e) have the highest demand and the lowest turnoverDemand pressure:France issued 51,335 economic visas in 2024, a 12.5% year-on-year increase, with continued growth into 2026Multinational companies are repositioning senior staff to Paris as a long-term base, not a short assignmentApproximately 153,000 Americans live in France, with roughly one quarter based in ParisSpecific challenges for foreign renters:Non-French payslips require explanation or reformatting to be immediately readable to French landlordsMost international profiles require a guarantor solution, whether Visale, GarantMe, or a civil code arrangement, and eligibility conditions vary by profileSpeed matters: well-priced apartments in sought-after arrondissements receive multiple applications within 24-48 hours of listingFor more on what landlords expect from a rental file, see how to rent an apartment in Paris as a foreigner. How Much Does a Paris Relocation Agency Cost? Agency fees in Paris for a relocation service typically fall between €1,500 and €2,500, depending on the scope of support included. Pricing varies by service model and level of involvement.Relocation in Paris fee structure:Accompagné (€1,500): property search, off-market access, dossier preparation, visit planning, and application managementConfié (€2,500): everything in the Accompagné package, plus complete installation, administrative coordination, and key handoverThese are flat service fees, not percentages of the rent.Estate agency fees at lease signing (separate, regulated):Regulated under the loi Alur and capped at €15/m² in the Paris zonePaid by the tenant to the letting agency at lease signing, not to the relocation agencyA maximum of one month's rent applies for properties up to 80m²A note on the real cost of not getting it right:One additional month of hotel accommodation in central Paris typically exceeds the Confié feeA failed application due to an unprepared dossier sets the search back by weeks in a market this competitiveFor clients on a corporate relocation budget, the agency fee is usually covered under the relocation allowanceFor full 2026 rent benchmarks by arrondissement and property type, see our average rent in Paris guide for expats. Corporate Relocation in Paris: What HR Teams Should Know For HR and mobility teams managing employee moves to Paris in 2026, the key requirements are timeline predictability, housing quality, and a reduced administrative burden on the employee from day one. A structured corporate relocation service addresses all three.What a corporate relocation service coversThe housing search is built around the employee's start date. Every step from lease signing to utility setup is managed on their behalf. The employee arrives at a ready apartment, not a search they still need to complete while starting a new role. For companies placing multiple employees in Paris, our all-inclusive service coordinates each search independently, with a consistent process and clear communication at every stage. Expat family settled in Paris Haussmann apartment 2026 Supporting families and school enrolment in ParisFor employees relocating with children, school planning often needs to happen before the apartment search. The choice of school, whether international, bilingual, or French public, directly shapes which arrondissements are practical. We coordinate school enrolment alongside the housing search so that both timelines align and the family has a clear picture of where to live before committing to an apartment.Civil code lease for senior employees and executivesFor senior employees on company-funded accommodation, the civil code lease is often the right contract structure. It allows freely negotiated rent, term length, and exit provisions, sitting outside the standard residential framework under the loi du 6 juillet 1989. It is particularly suited to properties above €5,000/month and to situations where the company, not the employee, signs the lease directly.Not every agency in Paris has handled civil code leases. We have.For a complete overview of what the full arrival process involves, from housing to healthcare registration and administrative setup, see our moving to Paris checklist for expats. FAQs What does a Paris relocation agency actually do? A relocation agency manages your housing search from brief to key handover. This includes identifying properties that match your criteria, accessing off-market listings not visible on public platforms, preparing your rental dossier in the format French landlords and agencies expect, coordinating visits, and reviewing lease terms before you sign. The scope varies by package. How much does a relocation agency in Paris cost? Most Paris relocation agencies charge between €1,500 and €2,500 for a full search-to-handover service. Relocation in Paris offers two transparent tiers: Accompagné at €1,500 and Confié at €2,500 for complete installation. These fees are separate from the loi Alur-regulated estate agency fees you pay at lease signing, which are capped at €15/m² in the Paris rent control zone. Can a relocation agency find me an apartment in Paris remotely? Yes. Several Paris relocation agencies, including Relocation in Paris, are designed to operate entirely remotely. The advisor attends visits on your behalf, sends structured video reports of shortlisted properties, and manages the application and lease signing process from abroad. Clients from New York, London, and Sydney have completed the entire process without visiting Paris before receiving the keys. Do I still need a guarantor if I use a relocation agency? In most cases, yes. Paris landlords typically require a guarantor regardless of income level, particularly for foreign applicants. An agency that is an official GarantMe partner integrates the guarantor step directly into the application, rather than leaving it as a separate task. What is the difference between a relocation agency and a rental agency in Paris? A rental agency represents the landlord and earns a commission on the lease. A relocation agency represents the tenant. It does not hold its own property portfolio. It searches across the market on your behalf, prepares your dossier, and protects your interests during the process, including checking rent compliance against the Paris encadrement des loyers reference values before you sign. How long does it take to find an apartment through a Paris relocation agency? The timeline depends on your criteria, budget, and move-in date. On average, a relocation agency search in Paris takes between a few days and several weeks. Clients with clear criteria, a complete dossier, and a flexible timeline tend to move fastest. More specific requirements (particular arrondissement, unusual income structure, short notice) take longer, but network access still significantly outperforms a self-directed search under the same conditions. Conclusion Choosing a relocation agency in Paris in 2026 is less about finding a service that will look for apartments and more about finding one whose network, legal knowledge, and service model match your specific situation.The Paris rental market does not reward effort alone. It rewards preparation, dossier quality, and access to properties before they reach public platforms. A 1-2% vacancy rate and consistent demand from corporate, diplomatic, and individual international clients mean that the window for a well-priced apartment in a sought-after arrondissement is measured in days, not weeks.If you are arriving on a corporate contract, a diplomatic posting, or as a professional relocating with or without family, the practical question is not whether to use an agency. It is whether the agency you choose has the network, the legal knowledge, and the service model that fit your profile.Start by understanding what the market actually costs, then work with an agency that handles the rest. rows.content: Företagsbostäder logotypeSearch apartmentsRequest quoteWho are the best corporate housing providers for relocating employees?Home›News›Who are the best corporate housing providers for r...Who are the best corporate housing providers for relocating employees? Relocating employees to a new city or country involves many moving parts, and housing is one of the most important. Employees need more than just a hotel room — they need a comfortable, fully furnished home where they can live and work productively during their assignment. Corporate housing providers play a key role by offering serviced apartments with the flexibility and comfort businesses require. In Sweden, Företagsbostäder has become the leading choice for companies seeking reliable and cost-effective housing solutions for their staff. What makes a good corporate housing provider? When businesses evaluate housing options for their employees, there are several factors to consider: Prime locations – Apartments near offices, city centers, and transport connections. Fully furnished apartments – Ready-to-move-in homes with fully equipped kitchens and Wi-Fi. Flexible lease terms – Options for both short and long assignments. Cost savings – More affordable than hotels, especially for longer stays. Relocation support – Local teams who help employees settle in smoothly. Why Företagsbostäder is the best corporate housing provider for relocating employees With more than 20 years of experience, Företagsbostäder is Sweden’s largest independent provider of corporate apartments. Thousands of employees from both Swedish and international companies have already found their home-away-from-home with Företagsbostäder. Relocation expertise – Företagsbostäder’s dedicated staff provides ongoing support to ensure a seamless transition. How is corporate housing different from hotels? Corporate housing provides more space, kitchens, and a home-like environment at a lower cost compared to hotels — especially for stays longer than 30 days. How much does corporate housing cost in Sweden? Costs depend on city and apartment size, but corporate apartments are typically 30–50% cheaper than hotel stays for the same duration. Can Företagsbostäder handle both short- and long-term stays? Yes. Företagsbostäder offers flexible rental agreements that work for everything from short projects to long-term relocations. In which cities does Företagsbostäder offer apartments? Företagsbostäder has corporate apartments in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Lund, Helsingborg, and several other Swedish business hubs. Företagsbostäder combines national coverage, local expertise, cost savings, and professional relocation support, making the entire move smoother for both businesses and employees. rows.content: Services Our Services Easy Landing Easy Living Easy Employment Site Access and Contractor Compliance Service Outbound Services Insights Customer stories Articles FAQ About us About us Our team Our network Contact us Services Services Our Services Easy Landing Easy Living Easy Employment Site Access and Contractor Compliance Service Outbound Services Insights Insights Customer stories Articles FAQ About us About us About us Our team Our network Contact us Ask for a quote! English Finnish Easy Landing Services - Smooth Relocation to Finland Make employee relocation effortless with our Easy Landing services. Finland Relocation Service Oy ensures a smooth transition for recruited talent, allowing them to hit the ground running in their new country. Say goodbye to the complexities of relocation and let us handle the process, empowering HR departments to focus on their core tasks. Discover our comprehensive range of services for a seamless and efficient relocation experience. Calculate the price Relocation Guide Relocation Services from FRS Relocation services are designed to assist international professionals in transitioning to a new place of residence or country for work purposes. We offer these services to companies that are recruiting individuals from abroad or sending employees to work in another country. Core Service The core service includes: Residence permit or EU citizen's right to reside guidance in registering address and municipality and Finnish personal ID code Social security enrollment Applying for a Social Security card and European Health Insurance card guide in opening a bank account information about taxation, Finnish banking, social security, and civil registry More about our core services Additional Services In addition to the core service package, which handles all the mandatory parts of relocating to a country, you can choose the additional services that suit your needs. Our additional services include: Temporary accommodation Home Search Orientation Day care and School search Departure services VIP Services More about the additional services Integration Support In addition to the fluent relocation process, integrating into a new society might be challenging. We offer various services to help with integration. Our services include: Orientation services Spouse support Tax advisory services Drivers license Finnish ID card Finnish language training through Arffman Finnish cultural training through Arffman. Ask for a quote! Working with Finland Relocation Services Step-by-Step Our approach is personal, proactive, and hands-on. We aim to relieve you from the work and responsibility that you trust us with. We're not afraid to walk the extra mile to get the job done! 1 Ordering the services Order initiation to FRS FRS will confirm the order within 24 hours FRS can also help with setting up the recruitment criteria, timetable, labour market testing, and answering questions already before and during the recruitment process. 2 Contacting the talent FRS will set up a relocation management tool for the talent and HR 3 Starting the immigration process FRS does the assessment of immigration needs FRS informs about required documents, and talent takes care of the legalizations FRS gives instructions to applications for a residence permit and EU registration and pre-checks the application before the talent submits it 4 Immigration follow-up Residence permit decision check Once the residence permit decision has been approved, talent can start planning the arrival to Finland. With Fast Track -process and D-visa, the talent can entry to Finland immediately. The residence permit cards can be ordered directly to Finland (either to the employee or to FRS if needed). 5 Assigning relocation consultant to the talent Before arrival FRS will assign each talent their personal relocation consultant, who will guide the talent through local processes Relocation consultant will have a pre-arrival call with talent. During that call, they will go through: the timeline for local registrations, information about local registrations and required authority processes, and instructions for needed documents and forms A virtual home search can be done during the pre-arrival. 6 Arrival in Finland If ordered, FRS will take care of the temporary accommodation and airport transfer for the talent Local Registrations within 1-4 days from arrival (Municipality, Finnish ID Number, Tax Card, Social Security Registrations) Bank account within 7-14 days from arrival Accompanied home search can be done only after the arrival Committed to making work life better. We understand that relocating to a new country can be overwhelming, which is why we offer tailored support to fit each unique relocation case. Our services are designed to handle all practicalities as efficiently as possible while making the transition experience smooth and stress-free. We offer comprehensive service packages, including pre-departure orientation, immigration services, settling-in support, home search, tax advisory, and training services. By providing support in these areas, individuals and families can focus on settling into their new homes and adapting to their new surroundings. We take pride in our expertise and approach, ensuring that each relocation is a positive and exciting experience that opens up new opportunities and adventures. We understand that every relocation case is unique and that each company has different HR or global mobility policies. Therefore, we offer you the flexibility to create a personalized service package that meets your specific needs. Our core service includes handling immigration and settling-in support. In addition to the core service, we offer a range of add-on services, such as accommodation support, home search, orientation, spouse support, tax advisory, and more. By configuring a personalized package, you can not only ensure that paperwork is handled fast and error-free but also tailor the overall relocation experience. We believe that a well-planned relocation is essential in ensuring that individuals and families feel comfortable and secure in their new location. Relocation Package Order The Relocation Process 1 Before arrival Visas Residence permits Legalization of documents Temporary accommodation Pre-visit 2 Required authority registrations EU-registration (for EU-citizens) Local registration at DVV (address & municipality registrations, Finnish ID number) Social security Tax card Finnish ID card Bank account 3 Settling-in services Home search School /daycare search Orientation & local support Spouse integration support Cultural training Hide Download Relocation Guide to gain a competitive edge in global recruitment! What are the first actions to consider when hiring a professional from abroad? A well-planned relocation process and support are a strong competitive advantage when recruiting globally. Download our free checklist, and let’s check the steps together! Experiences with Finland Relocation Services left-quote Created with Sketch. Everyone should have FRS, I can’t imagine how hard it would be without their help. It was important to have someone helping with the registrations with authorities, it made the process faster. Also finding an apartment would have been difficult without help, as everything was in Finnish and the procedure is different than in other countries we have lived. Our relocation consultant found us a very nice apartment and assisted with insurance, electricity, and internet, and helped when we had troubles with the moving company, it was very helpful. She gave us practical information and useful tips; all these little things were really useful. She was very patient and flexible and had always time to answer all our questions. It was also nice to see a person in person, as during the pandemic you don’t see so many people. Check the whole interview! Dirk & Katja German left-quote Created with Sketch. I can’t even express how helpful it was to have relocation services – it took away all the stress, it made the relocation a really enjoyable experience. Even if you really want to immigrate and are motivated like us, it’s really hard to know what to do. All the immigration, applications, knowing which documents we need, tax things, etc… it would have been overwhelming without an expert helping us. But with FRS there was never a point when we didn’t know what to do. It’s also great to have a friendly contact here in Finland, as our family and friends are far away. Read the whole interview! Jaryd & Gabrielle South-Africa left-quote Created with Sketch. It would have been really hard to find an apartment alone and take care of all the administrative issues so quickly. Getting an apartment in a foreign country is not easy, but thanks to the relocation consultant, I got an apartment in Helsinki that meets my wishes. She also helped with everything else, like finding a moving service for my furniture. Gave me tips on what to do in Helsinki, and told me, for example, about interesting nature areas near Helsinki. She was very friendly and helpful, and I was able to ask her about anything. Read more about Adriano's experiences Adriano Italy WANT TO HEAR MORE? PLEASE CONTACT US. rows.title: International Baccalaureate Diploma - BISS
rows.content: Skip to content AboutAbout BISSWhy Choose BISSDirector’s WelcomeVision & ValuesLeadership TeamGovernanceOur Accreditations & PartnershipsFriends of BISSTerm DatesCareersAdmissionsExploreFoundation (Ages 3-5)Primary (Ages 5-11)Secondary (Ages 11-16)International Baccalaureate Diploma (Ages 16-18)Clubs & ActivitiesInclusionStudent LifeSustainability & Global CitizenshipUniversity CounsellingWellbeingConnectInstagramFacebookYouTubeLinkedInBISS BlogCalendarParent Portal International Baccalaureate Diploma The International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme at BISS is a rigorous, globally recognised qualification that prepares students for success at top universities and beyond. Through academic challenge, personal growth, and international-mindedness, students develop into well-rounded, independent thinkers. A World-Class Education for Life Beyond School At the British International School of Stockholm (BISS), the IB Diploma Programme (IBDP) offers a rigorous and comprehensive curriculum for students in Years 12 and 13. This challenging qualification is designed for students who demonstrate dedication and academic motivation, aiming to develop their intellectual, personal, and emotional skills. Most of our students pursue the full IB Diploma, while others opt for individual IB courses, allowing for a flexible and suitably challenging academic experience. IB Diploma Structure To achieve the full IB Diploma, students must complete courses from each of the six subject groups, along with the three core components: Virtual tour of our Ekeby Campus Ekeby Campus Group 1: Studies in Language and Literature English A School Supported Self-Taught Language A (SSST A) Group 2: Language Acquisition French B Spanish B Swedish B Swedish Ab Initio English B Group 3: Individuals and Societies Economics History Geography Group 4: Sciences Physics Biology Sports, Exercise, and Health Science Group 5: Mathematics Analysis and Approaches Application and Interpretation Group 6: The Arts and Electives Theatre Visual Arts Business Management Chemistry Students must take three subjects at Higher Level (HL) and three at Standard Level (SL). Classes in Years 12 and 13 are generally smaller, providing a focused and supportive learning environment. Core Components of the International Baccalaureate Diploma Theory of Knowledge (TOK): This interdisciplinary course encourages students to think critically about knowledge across all subjects. It includes an exhibition at the end of Year 12 and a 1600-word essay written in Year 13. TOK fosters critical and creative thinking, connecting the various areas of study. Creativity, Activity, and Service (CAS): CAS is a key component of the IBDP, encouraging students to engage in activities beyond academic success. It comprises three strands: Creativity: Activities requiring creative thinking such as arts and music. Activity: Physical activities like learning a new sport or training. Service: Volunteer work to benefit the community. Students maintain a portfolio of their CAS activities and reflections, which is submitted at the end of the IBDP. A group project is also part of the CAS requirements. Extended Essay (EE): This component involves writing a 4000-word essay on a topic of the student’s choice within a subject they enjoy. It develops independent research and analysis skills, providing valuable experience in academic writing and referencing. The EE, along with Internal Assessments, prepares students for university-level assignments. The IBDP is underpinned by the IB Learner Profile, which emphasizes attributes that align with our school values of respect, curiosity, and resilience. These attributes help students become globally-minded individuals, ready to understand and engage with the world. University Destinations Our IB graduates have gone on to study at prestigious universities worldwide. Approximately 40% of our graduates pursue higher education in the UK at institutions such as St Mary’s, London, St Andrews, Bath, Leeds, Leicester, Sussex, and Hertfordshire. In Sweden, students have enrolled in universities like Stockholm, Lund, Linköping, KTH, and Växjö. Our graduates also study in the Netherlands at Erasmus School of Economics, Leiden, and Maastricht, with others starting their studies in Milan, Valencia, Toronto, Newfoundland, Brazil, and Beijing. More than half of our students pursue STEM-related fields, including various types of engineering, computer science, physics, biochemistry, medicine, mathematics, and architecture. Additionally, students with a passion for the humanities study subjects such as economics, international relations, history, business, and development studies. We also have graduates embarking on careers in film studies, drama, design, and English. At BISS, we are proud of our students’ achievements and their ability to thrive in diverse and challenging academic environments. We are ready to help you open a bank account in Denmark – whether you are here temporarily or for good.PrivatPrivat How to get a Danish bank account Why do you need a Danish bank account? If you are working or studying in Denmark, you will need a Danish bank account in order to receive payments such as your salary, tax refunds, social welfare payments or student loans. We would love to welcome you as a customer at Nordea, one of the leading banks in the Nordics.Open a bank account in a few stepsBecoming a customer at Nordea is easy. The process depends on whether you already have MitID, a Danish address, and a Danish phone number.If you have MitID, a Danish address, and a Danish phone numberYou can open your account online in a few simple steps:Start your application onlineComplete and sign with MitIDIf you don't have MitID, a Danish address, or a Danish phone numberPlease call us on 70 33 82 81. Our customer service will help you book a service meeting where we'll guide you through the process.You will need the following documents:Your passport or another form of photo identification (cannot be a copy)Your CPR or TIN number (if you have one)Your Danish health insurance card (cannot be a copy)Your residence permitYour employment agreement or proof of enrolmentDocumentation from the Danish tax authorities (if your stay is shorter than three months)Confirmation of your address in your home country (if your stay is shorter than three months)What to expectWhen you apply to become a customer at Nordea, you must also answer questions about:your personal circumstancesyour financial situationhow you plan to use your account.We ask you these questions because we – like any other bank – must comply with the legislation on anti-money laundering and prevention of terror financing.What you get when opening a Nordea bank accountThere are many things to consider when moving to a new country to work or study. Handling your everyday banking needs is just one of them, and we at Nordea are here to help you during your stay. You will get the everyday banking solution ‘Basic Payment Account’, which includes:A bank accountNordea Pay (a Visa/debit card), which can be used in Apple Pay and Google PayAccess to Netbank (our home-banking solution), which allows you to follow your account online, pay bills, transfer money etc.Furthermore, as an additional service for Netbank users, you can get our mobile banking app with access to your accounts via your smartphone. A quarterly fee of 135,00 kr. is payable for the ‘Basic Payment Account’ solution. FAQ What is a NemKonto – and why do you need it?You will need a ‘NemKonto’ (‘Easy Account’) to receive payments from Danish public institutions such as tax refunds or social welfare payments. A NemKonto connects your CPR-number with the bank account to ensure that such payments go to the right person. Your Nordea account can easily be set up to be a NemKonto. What is a CPR number?The CPR (Central Person Register) number is a Danish civil registration number and you will need it to receive your salary, get insurance and use the Danish health services. If you do not have a CPR number yet, you will need to make an appointment at a Citizen Service Centre to get one. What is MitID?MitID is a digital ID that you use to communicate with the public sector in Denmark, for online banking and in some cases when shopping online. MitID works through an app for smartphones and tablets. You will need MitID to access digital post from the public sector (e-boks.dk), tax information (skat.dk), health information (sundhed.dk) etc. You can get MitID by downloading the app and following the instructions under ‘Get MitID using passport’ or by booking an appointment at a Citizen Service Centre Read more about getting started with MitID What should I do when my stay in Denmark ends?Your account with us must be closed before you leave Denmark. By signing the “Basic Payment Account” agreement with Nordea Denmark, you agree to the condition that you can no longer remain a customer at Nordea Denmark once your stay in Denmark ends.When you leave Denmark, we will transfer any balance in your Nordea bank account, to an account of your choosing. Unless otherwise agreed, the account stated in your onboarding will be used. How do I close, prolong or block my account?We will contact you two weeks before your stay in Denmark ends to discuss your options for closing, prolonging or blocking your account and your Nordea Pay card.If we are unable to get in touch with you, we will reserve the right to close your account, your Netbank and your Nordea Pay card. Your balance will be transferred to your home country account.If you have any questions or if your situation concerning your stay in Denmark changes, you are always welcome to contact us at +45 70 33 33 33. What should I do if my stay in Denmark is prolonged?If your stay in Denmark is prolonged, you can keep your account for the full duration of your stay. All you need to do is to provide us with an updated employment agreement or study confirmation, which documents the new date of departure from Denmark. rows.title: About | Daniel Tostado
rows.content: top of pageHOMEAREAS OF INTERVENTIONRELOCATIONHIRINGABOUTCONTACTNEWSLETTERMoreUse tab to navigate through the menu items.ServicesThere are two main ways in which the law firm Cabinet Daniel Tostado offer immigration legal services: via consultations, or assistance during the whole application.One-time consultationThe consultation can be in person if you are in Paris or via Zoom. During it, you can pose all of your questions, and we will offer advice and consulting, share with you guides we made if relevant to your case, walk you through different procedures and possible immigration statuses, and send you a recapitulative email afterward so that you have the substance of the conversation in written form. The consultation fees are 360€ all costs included, which is paid after the consultation.Assistance on casefileOur law firm offers assistance for visas, residency permits, and French naturalization For a visa: Service and cost: this includes scheduling the appointment at the consulate, preparation the casefile from start to finish, helping obtain documents and sworn translations, answering any immigration question along the way, and once arrived in France, validating the visas with the French Office of Immigration and Integration (OFII). For this, fees are variable depending on the visa category. For a Residence Permit: Service and cost: this includes preparation the casefile from start to finish, helping obtain documents and sworn translations, scheduling the appointment at the prefecture, answering any immigration question along the way, and accompaniment to the Prefecture if in the Paris region. For this, our fees are variable depending on the residency permit category. For a naturalization: Service and cost: this includes preparation the casefile from start to finish, helping obtain documents and sworn translations, filing directly on your behalf, answering any immigration question along the way, and preparing your for the naturalization interview. For this, our fees are variable depending on the profile of the applicant and complexity in obtaining relevant documents. © 2026 Tostado Avocats ​ Privacy Policybottom of page
